title: CReal.integral does not depend on which uniform-continuity witness is supplied
statement: For F, a <= b, and ANY two witnesses u1, u2 that F is uniformly continuous on [a,b]: integral F a b hab u1 is Equiv to integral F a b hab u2. CReal.integral is the integral OF F, not 'the integral computed via this particular modulus' -- the value genuinely does not depend on the choice of convergence witness, which is not automatic for a construction built by picking a specific witness-driven mesh sequence.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.integral_witness_independent : ((x0 : ((x0 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal.le x1 x2) -> ((x4 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x0 x1 x2) -> ((x5 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x0 x1 x2) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.integral x0 x1 x2 x3 x4) (CReal.integral x0 x1 x2 x3 x5)))))))
